title: Robot state
description: Dynamic state of one robot. Health telemetry as seen by the coordinator is noisy; ground-truth states appear only in the event log.

RobotStatus.description: idle, moving, working, charging: what the robot is doing. stuck: immobilized in soft regolith. failed: has an active disabled fault. being_towed: attached to a tow in progress. offline: battery empty. lost: permanently gone (cannibalized) and never commandable again.

ActiveFault.description: A fault the robot currently has. A robot has at most one active fault per component.

field_repairable.description: Whether a field repair can clear it. Always true for degraded faults. False means only depot service or cannibalized parts can clear it.

wheel_slip.description: Fraction of commanded wheel travel lost to slip.

motor_current_ratio.description: Drive current relative to nominal (1.0 = new).

dust_coverage.description: Fraction of joints and panels covered by dust.

current_command.description: Command the robot is executing, if any.

faults.description: Active faults, at most one per component, ordered by component name. Empty when healthy.

in_relay_coverage.description: False when the robot cannot receive new commands until it re-enters coverage.

telemetry_t.description: When this state was measured. Equals the observation time unless the robot is out of coverage, in which case it is the time of last contact.
